A solitary figure stands barefoot on the edge of a weathered stone cliff overlooking a vast, mist-covered landscape that fades into a gray horizon. The subject is shown in profile with head bowed slightly, creating a quiet, contemplative silhouette against the pale sky. Long, tangled dark hair whips violently outward in every direction, becoming almost branch-like as it catches the wind. A rough, oversized cloak made of torn, weathered fabric drapes over the figure's shoulders, its frayed edges hanging in heavy strands that blend into dried grasses surrounding the rocky ledge.
